name: Neck Side Bend Stretch

instructions.description: Sit or stand tall with shoulders relaxed and eyes facing forward.
Let one ear drift toward the same-side shoulder without rotating the head.
For a slightly stronger stretch, place the hand lightly on top of the head without pulling.
Return to center slowly and repeat on the other side.

performanceMetrics.notes: Keep the stretch gentle and localized to the side of the neck.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Improve shoulder positioning first if the neck feels tense from poor posture.

commentsNotes: Do not force the chin upward or downward.
